_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_cast_at_sorcery_timing.py. t_casr_rider is Necromancy's first paragraph on a bare enchantment: castable as though it had flash, and sacrificed at the beginning of the next cleanup step when it was cast at a time a sorcery couldn't have been (307.1). t_casr_plain is the same enchantment without either line, kept live so every timing assertion is measured against a card the window really does refuse.

cards.name: Test Instant-Speed Rider
cards.oracle_text: You may cast this spell as though it had flash. If you cast it any time a sorcery couldn't have been cast, the controller of the permanent it becomes sacrifices it at the beginning of the next cleanup step.

abilities.text: If you cast it any time a sorcery couldn't have been cast, the controller of the permanent it becomes sacrifices it at the beginning of the next cleanup step.
